_comment: All The Stone 1 - mod catalog for download_mods.py. 'id' is the Modrinth slug (primary source), 'curseforge' is the CurseForge slug/id (secondary source), 'github' is a repo used as a last-resort release-asset source. 'search' is used when the slug no longer resolves.

mods.name: Ex Deorum
mods.why: Sieves, hammers, crooks, barrels and crucibles - the backbone of a stone world.

mods.name: KubeJS
mods.why: Scripts for the stone world, the pebble mechanic and the progression recipes.

mods.name: Better Advanced Tooltips
mods.why: KubeJS 1.21.1 no longer bundles it and loads it as a dependency (tag/component tooltips).

mods.name: Rhino
mods.why: JavaScript engine used by KubeJS (hard dependency).

mods.name: Architectury API
mods.why: Required by KubeJS and the FTB mods.

mods.name: Just Enough Items
mods.why: Recipe viewer; FTB Quests and Ex Deorum ship JEI integrations.

mods.name: Jade
mods.why: Block/entity tooltips so machines are actually usable.

mods.name: FTB Library
mods.why: Shared UI/config library for every FTB mod.

mods.name: FTB Teams
mods.why: Team/progress backend for FTB Quests.

mods.name: FTB Quests
mods.why: The quest book (two chapters: Welcome + Stone Age).

mods.name: FTB Ultimine
mods.why: Vein-mining through the solid stone world (a QoL must for stone packs).

mods.name: Mekanism
mods.why: Main tech progression (ore processing -> energy -> digital miner).

mods.name: Applied Energistics 2
mods.why: Storage/autocrafting endgame.

mods.name: GuideME
mods.why: Hard dependency of Applied Energistics 2 on 1.21.1 (it is the in-game guide engine).

mods.name: Powah
mods.why: Early/mid game energy generation.

mods.name: Ender IO
mods.why: Conduits + machines; heavy dependency chain, optional if it misbehaves.

mods.name: Mystical Agriculture
mods.why: Resource crops - the sustainable way to get ores without a world.

mods.name: Cucumber Library
mods.why: Dependency of Mystical Agriculture.

mods.name: Industrial Foregoing
mods.why: Laser drills, mob farms, resource automation.

mods.name: Titanium
mods.why: Dependency of Industrial Foregoing.

mods.name: Functional Storage
mods.why: Drawers - cheap bulk storage for pebbles/gravel/dust.

mods.name: Pipez
mods.why: Simple item/fluid/energy pipes.

mods.name: Sophisticated Backpacks
mods.why: Portable storage for long mining trips.

mods.name: Sophisticated Core
mods.why: Dependency of Sophisticated Backpacks.

mods.name: Cobble For Days
mods.why: Compact cobblestone generator. If it is not available for 1.21.1 NeoForge, Ex Deorum's barrel + lava + water setup covers it.

mods.name: Embeddium
mods.why: Renderer replacement (Sodium port for NeoForge).

mods.name: Sodium
mods.why: Alternative renderer - install this OR Embeddium, never both.

mods.name: Ferrite Core
mods.why: Big memory usage reduction.

mods.name: ModernFix
mods.why: Faster startup and lower memory usage.

mods.name: ImmediatelyFast
mods.why: Faster immediate-mode rendering (FPS).
